bio_md:
# 后少帝 · 主要事迹

后少帝刘弘是吕后幽杀前少帝后所立，名义上的汉家第四位皇帝。他承袭的仍是吕氏称制的政局：名分存疑，实权在太后，[[han-qian-shao|前少帝]]的下场就是悬在他头上的先例。

高后七年，赵王友幽死，诸吕与刘氏的积怨终于表面化。高后八年七月，吕太后崩，长久压抑的矛盾即刻爆发：太尉周勃入北军，与丞相陈平定计，尽诛诸吕，随后以「少帝及诸王皆非惠帝子」为由废杀后少帝，迎代王[[han-wen-di|刘恒]]入长安即位。

后少帝在位四年，史书几乎没有留下他自己的任何事迹——他存在的意义，就是吕氏称制的最后一枚图章。诸吕既灭，这枚图章连同两个少帝一起被历史抹去，汉统由此重归刘氏。他的悲剧与文帝的即位互为表里：一个是称制终局的注脚，一个是新朝局的起点。

> 参考：点校本《史记·吕太后本纪》、《汉书》卷003《高后纪》、卷004《文帝纪》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Hong, the Later Young Emperor, was enthroned after Empress Lü had the Former Young Emperor slain — nominally the fourth emperor of Han, inheriting the same regime of Lü regency: his title doubtful, real power in the empress dowager's hands, and the fate of

hanging over him.

In the seventh year of the regency, King You of Zhao was starved to death, and the accumulated hatred between the Lü clan and the Liu house broke into the open. In the eighth year, the empress dowager died, and the long-suppressed conflict exploded at once: Grand Commandant Zhou Bo took the Northern Army, and with Chancellor Chen Ping he destroyed the entire Lü clan; declaring that "the young emperor and the kings are no sons of Emperor Hui," they slew the Later Young Emperor and summoned the king of Dai,

, to Chang'an.

In his four years the histories record almost nothing of the Later Young Emperor himself — his whole existence was the last seal of the Lü regency. With the Lü destroyed, that seal and both young emperors were wiped from the record together, and the Han succession returned to the Liu house. His tragedy and Emperor Wen's accession are two sides of one coin: the footnote to a regency's end, and the beginning of a new order.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Shiji*, "Basic Annals of Empress Lü," and the *Hanshu*, ch. 3 and ch. 4 (Benji of Empress Lü and of Emperor Wen); Tan Qixiang's atlas, vol. 2.
